task_description.overview: Visualize the cumulative number of events over time to detect temporal clustering and changes in completeness magnitude.
steps: Load event times and magnitudes from input.
If provided, load a list of cut-off magnitudes (mcs) and define delta_m.
For each cut-off magnitude, filter events above that threshold.
Compute the cumulative count of events over the time axis.
Plot one or multiple cumulative count curves with optional grid and styling.
Return or save the time-series figure.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Plot the seismicity through time. Loading the earthquake catalog at {catalog_path}, bin the magnitudes with bin width {fmd_bin}. Plot a figures to show the seismicity through time: the cumulative count of seismic events through time (normalized to 0-1). 
 Note: 1) The `seismostats` libarary provide some functions to do catalog statistic analysis and ploting. Please refer to the `seismostats` provide some functions to assist. 
 2) Save the seismicity through time plot to {result_plot} and the seismicity through time data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content}.
